assumptions_challenged: That a characterized MCB/WCB for SGL-001 already exists and is qualified for downstream manufacture.
That orthogonal intact‑EV identity assays (with LLOQ, specificity, precision) have been validated for the program.
That a mechanism-linked, stability‑indicating potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint has been developed and validated for SGL-001.
That three GMP-like scale-up batches with release, stability, and potency comparability have been produced and demonstrate reproducible manufacturing.
That rodent intranasal biodistribution data for SGL-001 are predictive of larger‑species CNS exposure without matched intact‑EV analytics and cross‑species controls.
falsification_conditions: Provide MCB/WCB creation and characterization records (origin, banking protocol, qualification data) demonstrating a qualified source bank for SGL-001.
Submit defined orthogonal QC panel documentation (markers, methods, SOPs) showing which particle/protein/lipid assays will be used and acceptance criteria.
Deliver validation reports for intact‑EV identity assays showing LLOQ, specificity (including controls separating non‑vesicular signal), precision, accuracy, and robustness.
Deliver validation reports for a mechanism‑linked, stability‑indicating potency assay with demonstrated correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint.
Provide full release, stability, and potency comparability data from ≥3 GMP‑like scale‑up batches demonstrating reproducible CQAs and release results across lots.

Supply raw cross‑species biodistribution datasets with intact‑EV specificity controls (e.g., free‑label controls, non‑vesicular fractions, orthogonal assays) demonstrating that measured CNS signal maps to intact EV and is reproducible across lots and species.
strongest_objection: The program lacks any program-specific, evidence-backed CMC and analytics demonstrating a qualified source-cell bank, orthogonal intact-EV identity assays, validated mechanism-linked potency assay, and reproducible GMP-like batch data—so advancing to formulation comparability or cross‑species biodistribution bridging is premature. The supplied guidance (MISEV2023) calls for these items but does not constitute program evidence that they exist for SGL-001.
